scripts.package:macos: npm run package:macos:compile && npm run package:macos:bundle
scripts.package:macos:compile: node scripts/build-mcp-relay.mjs && node scripts/build-agent-runtime.mjs universal-apple-darwin && tauri build --no-bundle --target universal-apple-darwin
